summary.text: Rah Reinholz is the Democratic candidate for Wyoming House of Representatives District 17 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Elizabeth Bingham.
A laborer, Reinholz describes being a multigenerational Wyomingite and a Sweetwater County delegate to the Democratic convention in a Ballotpedia survey.

paragraphs.text: Rah Reinholz attended Western Wyoming Community College, and Ballotpedia lists a career as a laborer.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Reinholz said they have worked as an election judge many times and attended the Democratic convention as a delegate for Sweetwater County.
Reinholz advanced from the August 18, 2026 Democratic primary for District 17.

In the survey, Reinholz listed investing in education and child care to keep young people in Wyoming, affordable and accessible health care including Medicaid expansion, and managing natural resources for Wyoming residents as key messages.
Reinholz also proposed a 5 percent corporate income tax on large corporations.
